fieldNotes.truckGate: Staffed entrance confirmed in Street View (pano wQlU-7y2O2FxR9iJNluPDA, 2012-10): controlled checkpoint at the SW property entrance with lane-control signage and chain-link perimeter fence across the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small reddish gatehouse booth with windows on multiple sides, awning, and a roof-mounted security camera dome, set in the median splitting the entry/exit lanes. Footprint ~1-2 vehicles.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point; the guard booth median splits one inbound lane (right) from one 'EXIT ONLY' lane (left) at the same gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Long internal loop driveway from the guard gate up to the west dock apron provides interior queue/holding room before docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: West truck yard holds a row of ~11 visible drop trailers backed to the dock wall plus marked yard space; capacity ~18.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~14 doors estimated along the west building face from z20 imagery (trailers obscure exact count).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within Rochester MN city limits in a developed NW industrial park (warehouses, apartments, retail nearby) fronting US-52 — Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
